name: KB HTML Site Importer & Visual Editor
author: Key2Blogging

sections.description:
KB HTML Site Importer & Visual Editor helps WordPress administrators import AI-generated or static HTML websites from ZIP files and publish them as WordPress Pages or Posts.

Upload a ZIP containing index.html or index.htm, keep the original folder structure, preview the result at desktop, tablet and mobile sizes, edit source files, and make quick visual changes from WordPress.

Key features

  • Import complete static HTML/CSS/JavaScript websites from ZIP files.
  • Publish imported websites as WordPress Pages or Posts.
  • Preserve the original folder and asset structure.
  • Edit HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON, XML, text and SVG source files.
  • Quick Visual Edit for text, link URLs, button destinations, colors, images and image alt text.
  • Full-screen visual editing mode for distraction-free changes.
  • Responsive desktop, tablet and mobile previews.
  • Register imported raster images in the WordPress Media Library.
  • Replace individual image assets while keeping existing file references.
  • Replace a complete website ZIP while keeping the existing WordPress URL.
  • Download the currently managed website as a ZIP.
  • Create backups when individual managed files are edited or replaced.
  • Blocks server-side executable files and server configuration files inside imported ZIP files.

Security and permissions

Importing and editing features are restricted to users with both manage_options and unfiltered_html, which limits raw script editing to appropriately trusted administrators. State-changing requests use WordPress nonces, uploaded ZIP paths are validated before extraction, and unsafe archive paths, server-side executable files, and server configuration files are rejected.

KB HTML Site Importer & Visual Editor does not make automatic requests to external services. The plugin dashboard contains optional links to Key2blogging support and YouTube resources; those sites are only opened when an administrator clicks the links.

Multi-page imports

Each HTML/HTM file becomes a WordPress page. Nested paths use hyphenated slugs. WordPress adds a suffix if an unrelated page already owns a slug. Select a non-Plain permalink structure for clean URLs.

For existing imports, use Sync HTML Pages. Matching source paths retain their page IDs. Sources removed during ZIP replacement become drafts. Navigation links are rewritten at render time; arbitrary JavaScript navigation and form endpoints are not converted.

Visual editor

A compact, single-row toolbar sits above the website preview. Responsive controls are available from the Preview dropdown. Undo, Redo and Revert original are available there. The settings panel floats over the preview and remembers its position and size. Toggle the sidebar with the settings icon, or close it with its close button or Escape. Clicking a page element opens its settings. Inspector sections behave as an accordion.

The initial preview is Desktop at 1920 × 1080. Choose Desktop, Tablet or Mobile, select a preset, or enter a custom width and height. Rotate swaps dimensions. Fit preview scales the display while preserving the selected CSS viewport dimensions. Device presets simulate viewport size, not device hardware or browser behavior.

Select text, headings, buttons, images or containers. Use text formatting, button links and hover colors, image controls, and Layout & box model controls. Clear a layout field to remove its inline override. The element breadcrumb selects ancestors.

Click supported text in the preview to edit it directly; the caret is placed in the selected text. Text edits save automatically after a short pause without refreshing the preview. Text size changes apply to the site text, not the editor field. Undo remains available from the toolbar. Administrators also see the WordPress admin bar and a floating Visual Edit button on imported live pages. Replacement image uploads remain a separate operation. Use the live-page arrow to open the published page in a new tab; the × exits the editor.

The Element CSS section edits inline declarations for the selected element. It also displays accessible matching stylesheet rules for reference. Saved declarations apply at all viewport sizes; this control does not rewrite shared stylesheets or create media queries. Unsupported or unsafe declarations are rejected.

Revert original restores the selected source file’s baseline captured before visual changes. Saved visual revisions use HTML backup files rather than copies of page content in the database. The code editor also includes a Wrap code option.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the html-site-importer-visual-editor folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate KB HTML Site Importer & Visual Editor from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Open Pages > HTML Site Importer in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter a website title, choose Page or Post, and upload a ZIP containing index.html or index.htm.
  5. Use Edit Code, Visual Edit, or Preview to manage the imported website.
sections.faq:
What should the ZIP contain?

The ZIP must contain an index.html or index.htm file. CSS, JavaScript, fonts, images and other static assets can be included in the same folder structure.

Can I import PHP or other server-side code?

No. KB HTML Site Importer & Visual Editor is designed for AI-generated or other static websites. Server-side executable file types and server configuration files such as .htaccess, web.config and php.ini are rejected during ZIP validation.

Can I edit an imported website after publishing it?

Yes. The plugin includes source-code editing, responsive previews, image replacement, and a Quick Visual Edit mode for common text, link, color and image changes.

Are imported images added to the Media Library?

Supported raster images are registered in the WordPress Media Library so they can be managed alongside other WordPress media.

Does the plugin contact Key2blogging or YouTube automatically?

No. The dashboard contains optional resource links, but the plugin does not automatically send site or visitor data to those websites.

Where are imported website files stored?

Imported website files and edit backups are stored under the WordPress uploads directory. The plugin keeps the website’s relative folder structure intact.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Import and sync multiple HTML pages with WordPress permalinks; preserve page IDs when replacing a ZIP.
  • Improve visual editing with inline text, button and style controls, layout settings, CSS editing, undo and revisions.
  • Add a responsive preview workspace with device presets, a draggable settings panel and a compact toolbar.
  • Save edits without preview refresh; add live-page admin-bar access and code wrapping.
  • Refresh the dashboard with readable full-width styling and links to each imported page.
  • Address WordPress coding-standard findings and improve request validation.

1.0.0

  • Initial release with static-site ZIP import, Page/Post creation and code and visual editors.
  • Added responsive previews, Media Library support, secure ZIP validation and WordPress Filesystem operations.
